# Thread & Stack

> Ops & Strategy that shifts culture. Thread & Stack helps purpose-led founders and teams align what they say with how they work, so growth feels human instead of hectic.

Thread & Stack is the studio of Brendan Rodgers, a designer, strategist, and certified Notion partner based in the UK. Two service pillars: Narratives & Strategy (positioning, brand story, go-to-market clarity) and Notion & Systems Consultancy (workspace design, operating systems, automation). The site is a marketing site for prospective clients, collaborators, and event attendees.

Brand essentials: "Stories that land. Systems that stick." Addresses the creative tax that drains makers and small teams. Founder Brendan is both a designer and a strategist; not VAT registered; standard terms are 50% upfront, 50% on delivery.

- [Retainer: Scale-Up](https://threadandstack.com/retainer/scaleup): Senior fractional engagement for scale-ups.
